geometry_and_combat.finding: The corridor screenshot shows the original wall and sandbags beside the player. The emulator's exported cover triangles are restricted to six courtyard statics around X=293..299, Z=65..76; none cover this outpost corridor, Thrax or bunker. This asset therefore yields zero sampled outpost cover even where original geometry is visible. It does not establish final-live ballistic line of sight.

geometry_and_combat.exact_source: src/Rasa.Game/Managers/BehaviorManager.cs CheckForAttackableEntityInRange lines 100-160; CreatureThink fight action around 560-590; src/Rasa.Game/Managers/WeaponAttackManager.cs lines 216-245; src/Rasa.Game/Managers/CoverGeometryManager.cs lines 102-146
geometry_and_combat.finding: Current creature acquisition and attack eligibility are distance based, with no geometry ray in these paths. Direct ranged player attacks check target identity but only the melee branch enforces MaxRange; boot-camp cover sampling scales damage and has no outpost triangles. A copied-client hit or kill from behind a wall would therefore be emulator functionality, not proof of original line of sight.

bounded_approach: The only newly ordinary-reached measured hold point is (-61.8,87.9,75.3), about 28.0 m horizontally from the seeded Thrax engagement point. Inspect target visibility and actual sightline there before advancing. The original recorded player engagement XZ (-75.74,84.21) is 16.6 m away by this navmesh and about 11.5 m from that target, but this route has not been ordinary-client traversed from the new checkpoint. Avoid calling either point safe until a client capture measures enemy acquisition, incoming damage and shot behavior.
decision: No seed, cover or combat change is justified by navmesh and screenshots alone. The outpost cover/line-of-sight gap is concrete in current code, but final-live geometry sampling and attack rules must be recovered or tested before a faithful correction is chosen.
